dueTime.description: The time of day it is due at, to the minute (#474); none, or null, for a task due all day. Floating without a timeZone.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone dueTime is meant in (#474), one the backend knows; only with a dueTime. None, or null, for a floating time, which follows the reader's clock.

dueAt.description: The moment a task with a timeZone is due at (#474), worked out on every read: a time in a daylight-saving gap moves later, one in an overlap is its earlier moment. Null for an all-day or floating task.

attachments.description: Its available attachments (#204). Always sent; optional in the schema so the board still validates a task from a backend rolled back to before attachments.
